# agentic-comments

Comment threads and suggestions anchored to any content, from people and agents.

Keywords: comments,threads,mentions,suggestions,annotations,collaboration,agents,yjs.

- SDK: import { Comments, Suggestions, textAnchor } from "agentic-comments". The host calls stamp(); an agent never does.
- Plain text anchors: import { createAnchor, resolveAnchor, mapRange } from "agentic-comments/anchor". No Yjs. resolveAnchor maps through edits, then falls back to quote + context, else orphaned.
- Threads live on a Yjs document and merge across replicas.
- Lifecycle: comments.editMessage, deleteMessage, deleteThread, exportPerson, erasePerson (and the same on the CLI, MCP, HTTP API, and client). Only the author may change their own messages; comments:moderate may change anyone's.
- React panel: import { CommentsPanel, createClient, mayDecide } from "agentic-comments/ui" and "agentic-comments/ui.css" (with agentic-design/styles.css). Threads, quotes, replies, resolve and reopen, agent badge, accept and reject. An agent never decides its own suggestion. Peer: react, react-dom.
- Events: new Notifications(comments, suggestions).subscribe(listener). Ids only, never text.
- CLI: agentic-comments <command>. MCP: agentic-comments mcp. Both use a local store file.

## Docs
